document_template_versions_sod_ck.name: document_template_versions_sod_ck
document_template_versions_sod_ck.value: "document_template_versions"."approved_by" is null or "document_template_versions"."submitted_by" is null or "document_template_versions"."approved_by" <> "document_template_versions"."submitted_by"

document_template_versions_approved_ck.name: document_template_versions_approved_ck
document_template_versions_approved_ck.value: "document_template_versions"."status" <> 'approved' or ("document_template_versions"."approved_by" is not null and "document_template_versions"."approved_at" is not null and "document_template_versions"."effective_from" is not null)

document_template_versions_retired_ck.name: document_template_versions_retired_ck
document_template_versions_retired_ck.value: "document_template_versions"."status" <> 'retired' or ("document_template_versions"."retired_by" is not null and "document_template_versions"."retired_at" is not null)

generated_documents_ready_ck.name: generated_documents_ready_ck
generated_documents_ready_ck.value: "generated_documents"."status" <> 'ready' or ("generated_documents"."checksum_sha256" is not null and ("generated_documents"."output_format" = 'html' or "generated_documents"."file_attachment_id" is not null))

generated_documents_reprint_ck.name: generated_documents_reprint_ck
generated_documents_reprint_ck.value: ("generated_documents"."reprint_of_id" is null and "generated_documents"."reprint_no" = 0) or ("generated_documents"."reprint_of_id" is not null and "generated_documents"."reprint_no" > 0 and "generated_documents"."reprint_reason_code" is not null)

generated_documents_void_ck.name: generated_documents_void_ck
generated_documents_void_ck.value: "generated_documents"."status" <> 'void' or ("generated_documents"."voided_by" is not null and "generated_documents"."voided_at" is not null and "generated_documents"."void_reason" is not null)

label_jobs_reprint_ck.name: label_jobs_reprint_ck
label_jobs_reprint_ck.value: ("label_jobs"."reprint_of_id" is null and "label_jobs"."reprint_no" = 0) or ("label_jobs"."reprint_of_id" is not null and "label_jobs"."reprint_no" > 0 and "label_jobs"."reprint_reason_code" is not null)

label_jobs_void_ck.name: label_jobs_void_ck
label_jobs_void_ck.value: ("label_jobs"."voided_at" is null and "label_jobs"."voided_by" is null and "label_jobs"."void_reason" is null) or ("label_jobs"."voided_at" is not null and "label_jobs"."voided_by" is not null and "label_jobs"."void_reason" is not null)

label_jobs_printed_ck.name: label_jobs_printed_ck
label_jobs_printed_ck.value: "label_jobs"."status" <> 'printed' or ("label_jobs"."printed_by" is not null and "label_jobs"."printed_at" is not null)
